questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up next to the car in front of the parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up next to the car in front of the parking space.
questions.explanation: After you find a parking space, check traffic, and signal, stop parallel to the front car. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must let the driver on the right go first. The left driver can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to places. They help drivers who don't know the area.

questions.question: How should you treat railroad crossings?

options.text: They are safe. Trains rarely come.
They are good places to park.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and instructions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
Keep the same speed the whole way through.
Speed up when you enter, slow down when you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve and speed up gradually as you leave it. Speeding up as you enter makes it harder to control your car.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, it means they are turning right. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What do pentagon-shaped signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagon signs show you are in a school zone. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians.

questions.question: How much alcohol does your body process in one hour?
questions.explanation: Your body processes about one drink in one hour. However, many things affect how alcohol impacts you, including how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your body weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points downward, it means they are stopping. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon with all lights off?

options.text: You may continue, but drive carefully.
You must stop completely before driving carefully.
You must slow down and get ready to stop.
You must stop completely and let pedestrians cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may continue, but drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon helps pedestrians cross safely. It only works when a pedestrian activates it. When all lights are off, you may continue with caution.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means go slowly and be careful. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on slippery roads?

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, do not make sudden moves with the steering wheel or pedals. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: What are signs called that tell drivers to obey a specific instruction?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs require drivers to follow the instruction. Breaking the rule can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending soon on the right side.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
One lane is ending soon on the left side.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending soon on the right side.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, what is the minimum following distance you should keep?
questions.explanation: More distance between your car and others gives you more time to react. Keep at least three seconds of distance in normal conditions. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going different directions. Broken lines mean drivers next to the line may pass when it is safe.

questions.question: Which statement about motorcycles is true?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, your vehicle must move completely into the left lane.
A motorcycle's brake lights always turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, your vehicle must move completely into the left lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will not happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At unmarked railroad crossings, slow down and prepare to stop. Look both ways on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until it passes.

questions.question: How far might a fully loaded tractor-trailer need to stop when traveling at 55 mph?
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers need much longer distances to stop than small cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer needs about 400 feet to stop from 55 mph.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to ask other drivers to let you through.
Drive around the rear of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, your car will not be pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: When can you NOT cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front of you is broken down.
When passing on the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes only if it is safe and does not interfere with other traffic.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your vehicle does not have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), what should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.

questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. Your car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.
